description: Search the official US Harmonized Tariff Schedule by plain-language product description and get back candidate HTS lines with their duty rates. Classification is the hard part of importing and the usual place a costly mistake is made, so this returns several candidates with their descriptions rather than pretending there is one obvious answer.

description.description: What the product is, in plain words. For example 'women's merino wool leggings' or 'brassieres'.

limit.description: How many candidates to return, 1 to 40. Default 15.

name: find_hts_code
title: Find candidate US tariff codes for a product
